description: Get the user's upcoming hotel, flight, and rental car reservations. Use this to ground recommendations in real plans (e.g. "your Tokyo trip is May 15-20, want me to find restaurants?"), check upcoming confirmation numbers, or answer what flights/cars/hotels are already booked. Returns dates, confirmation numbers, status, costs/rates, loyalty programs and earnings, savings/AutoSave signals, flight segment details, ticket class, miles redeemed, refundability/cancellation timing, and seat assignments when Gondola has parsed real row+letter seats from airline emails.
name: get_upcoming_trips
